description: This file defines API routes for managing classes and class sessions in a gym management system, using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and deleting classes and sessions, with role-based access control.

methods.name: create_class_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new class, accessible by admin or staff roles.

methods.name: list_classes_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to list all classes, accessible by any authenticated user.

methods.name: update_class_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing class, accessible by admin or staff roles.

methods.name: delete_class_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a class, accessible by admin or staff roles.

methods.name: create_session_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new class session, accessible by admin or staff roles.

methods.name: list_sessions_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to list class sessions, optionally filtered by class_id, accessible by any authenticated user.
